text_to_image_prompt:
Use case: spatial production design. Scene: 多题材场景60组 · 29 · 风帆空港.
Environment:  An empty airship landing pier projecting from a floating stone island above bright clouds, a small elegant cream canvas sailing airship moored at the far edge, pale wood boards, bronze cleats, ivory wind banners and a low arched customs pavilion. Floating islands in the distance, cinematic eye-level approach, clean open deck, no crew or animal-shaped vessels.
Visual medium: realistic live action; keep the scene's stated palette, light and tactile materials.
Required image format: ONE independent orthographic architectural elevation or cut section of the principal facade / interior wall. Show openings, vertical structure, floor levels, stair and roof relationships where visible. Readable architectural profile with restrained white margin and a short elevation title.
A coherent environment-only concept reconstruction for story staging. No people, characters, animals, humanoid statues, faces, silhouettes or human reflections. Legible spatial proportions and usable paths. Not surveyed construction documentation.
original_prompt: Fix this architectural elevation of a floating airship harbor. Keep the left cliff, ivory glazed dome pavilion and horizontal bridge intact. The airship on the right is erroneously vertically oriented. Replace ONLY the airship with a physically coherent front elevation: horizontal cream oval balloon overhead, brass keel and wooden passenger gondola hanging BELOW the balloon, gondola boarding door at exactly the bridge deck height, fabric sails rising above and to the sides, no part of balloon below the gondola. Pure white presentation background; empty environment, no people. Landscape architectural elevation.
